employed_workers.note: From 2021 NSO computes labour figures under ICLS19: people working only to produce goods for their own use in agriculture, forestry and fishery no longer count as employed (ICLS13 before 2021; Statistical Yearbook 2025, p.151 footnote). Years before 2021 and 2021 onward are not strictly comparable.

fdi_registered_capital.unit: million USD total registered FDI capital in the year (new + supplementary + capital contributions; can be negative)

hdi.note: HDI from 2020 uses the World Bank's 2017 PPPs (Statistical Yearbook 2025, p.1485 footnote); 2018 and 2019 come from the 2022 yearbook, the first to print HDI by province.

income_per_capita_monthly.unit: thousand VND per person per month
income_per_capita_monthly.note: From the Household Living Standards Survey: by province every two years until 2018 (2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018), every year from 2019.

informal_employment_rate.note: From 2021 NSO computes labour figures under ICLS19: people working only to produce goods for their own use in agriculture, forestry and fishery no longer count as employed (ICLS13 before 2021; Statistical Yearbook 2025, p.151 footnote). Years before 2021 and 2021 onward are not strictly comparable.

population.note: Average population adjusted to the Population and Housing Census of 1 April 2019 (Statistical Yearbook 2019 footnote); 2010-2018 are NSO's revised figures in PX-Web V02.03-07, which differ from the estimates the 2010-2018 yearbooks printed (e.g. Hà Nội 2018: 7,914.5 thousand against 7,520.7).

poverty_rate_income.note: Income poverty, not multidimensional: households below the Government's poverty line for 2011-2015 (updated by CPI; Statistical Yearbook 2018, p.853 footnote), 2010-2015 only. Not comparable with the multidimensional rates from 2016.

poverty_rate_multidimensional.note: Multidimensional poverty from 2016: 2016-2021 under the 2016-2020 standard (income and deprivation in basic social services; Statistical Yearbook 2018, p.853 footnote), from 2022 under the 2022-2025 standard (Statistical Yearbook 2025, p.934 footnote), so the 2021-2022 step is a definition change. Before 2016 the yearbooks print income poverty: those rates (2010-2015) are a separate series, not drawn on this lens.

tea_production.unit: thousand tonnes fresh bud (main producers only)

tourism_travel_turnover.unit: billion VND (travel agency turnover, current prices)

trained_labour_share.note: From 2021 NSO computes labour figures under ICLS19: people working only to produce goods for their own use in agriculture, forestry and fishery no longer count as employed (ICLS13 before 2021; Statistical Yearbook 2025, p.151 footnote). pci.note: Method break in 2025: PCI 2022 and 2024 are VCCI's published composite scores for the 63 former provinces (2024: the top 30 only); 2025 covers the 34 new provinces with new sub-indices and weights, and its composite is computed by the atlas from the 9 sub-indices and the weights VCCI published (PCI 2025 report, Figure A1.1 p.138): VCCI does not publish a PCI 2025 composite score.
